{{Quote|I'd get the lightsaber back, but Rosen has it--and he's holed up in the industrial area. It's too dangerous, and I can't exactly afford help.|Mila Escalus to [[Darth Nox|Kallig]]|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Mila Escalus''', nicknamed '''Mil''' by her father, was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was the keeper of [[Kallig's lightsaber]], but her father had gambled it away and lost it to [[Gyl Rosen]].
